response.sql: WITH tot AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS t FROM scanfeatures), units AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, s.articount AS artifact_count, CAST(s.articount AS REAL) / tot.t AS share FROM scanfeatures s, tot WHERE tot.t IS NOT NULL AND tot.t <> 0), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM units) SELECT u.site_code, u.artifact_count, u.share, u.share - av.a AS share_minus_avg FROM units u, av WHERE av.a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (u.share - av.a) IS NULL, (u.share - av.a) DESC LIMIT 10
